headline: Marius Budăi: Better early elections than voting for a prime minister who announces he will continue Bolojan's government
summary: PSD deputy Marius Budăi said he prefers early elections to voting for a prime minister who would continue Bolojan's government. He cited austerity, tax increases and income cuts.
why: Political instability and fiscal consolidation in Romania affect government borrowing costs, the leu and the outlook for the country's budget deficit.

original_headline: Marius Budăi: Mai bine la anticipate decât să votăm un premier care ne anunţă că va continua guvernarea Bolojan
